summary: Phase 9 blocked: standalone nvar_transfer_from_1var lemma cannot be proved as conceived. The depth gap (need depth-(K+1) arity-3 from depth-(K+1) arity-2) is irreducible with available NF algebra. A sorry-free convenience wrapper exist_transfer_at_full_depth was added. Exhaustive analysis confirms 5 approaches fail. Requires architectural redesign.

sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Fundamental depth gap: exist_transfer_from_full_agree gives depth-K arity-3 from depth-(K+1) arity-2, goal needs depth-(K+1) arity-3. Gap is 1 depth level per arity increase. Irreducible with pure NF algebra.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Research architectural alternatives: (a) inner depth cascade 0->K+1 with increasing arity, (b) direct sub_nf evaluation using atoms from depth-K 3-var + quantifiers from exist_transfer at d<=K-1, (c) reformulate proof to avoid 3-var transfer entirely

blockers: The standalone nvar_transfer_from_1var lemma requires proving: from depth-(d+1) 1-var at each component + order matching → depth-(d+1) r-var. The quantifier step needs a single witness z' with correct orders relative to ALL env components. cross_extend_bwd_1var gives z' with correct order relative to ONE component only. Prior-UZ bounding fails because the two witnesses from different components have no guaranteed relative ordering.

5 approaches exhausted: (1) induction on d with all r (order matching gap), (2) depth upgrade K→K+1 via 1-var (same gap), (3) exist_transfer at d=K (already maximal), (4) reconstruction_depth_agree (fixed arity), (5) Prior-UZ dual bounding (witnesses not guaranteed in correct relative positions)

continuation_context.key_discovery: exist_transfer_from_full_agree at d=K is the MAXIMUM available from pure NF algebra. The gap is exactly 1 depth per 1 arity increase. The fundamental issue: cross_extend_bwd_1var from a single base component cannot produce a witness with correct orders relative to MULTIPLE components simultaneously.
continuation_context.recommended_next_research: Investigate whether the w_nf approach (ih_strong → depth-K 3-var FULL agreement at [w,x,t]/[w_nf,x',t'] with w_nf in zone 3) can close the sorry DIRECTLY by showing nf_eval N (K+1) 3 [w_nf,x',t'] sub_nf via: (a) atoms from depth-K atom agreement, (b) quantifiers from exist_transfer_from_full_agree applied to the depth-K 3-var agreement (gives d<=K-1 at arity 4). The inner quantifiers of sub_nf are at depth K, which asks about depth-K 4-var. Can depth-(K-1) 4-var suffice because sub_nf.2 chi4 only depends on chi4's evaluation, not its full depth-K structure? Research whether nf_eval at depth K+1 can be decomposed into depth-K atoms + depth-(K-1) quantifier conditions.
